answer: A bond is posted per identity and released only after three unrelated confirmations, and no identity may audit the account it recruited. The recruiting vertex is the only place the graph can be gamed, so it is the one place a stranger must sign. A walnut of 500 POA sits locked per seat for a full epoch past the last confirmation. The ivory part is that wait, capital at rest with no return. Farms price the bond and forget the idle epoch behind it.
